decision: The standalone runtime composes all capabilities through the shared adapter-factory shape, persists core state in SQLite, and requires durable manual approval of an exact brief snapshot before any channel delivery.
implemented_capabilities: pending, approved, and rejected manual approval queue
one-shot and recurring adapter-composed CLI cycles
durable idempotent JSONL outbox reference channel
architectural_invariants: pending approvals never advance a source cursor
delivery publishes the stored approved brief snapshot rather than retry output
processing and delivery keys use collision-safe versioned encodings
concrete adapter names remain outside src/core
adapter settings remain opaque to the core and are validated by the adapter
SQLite state survives restart and all logical writes are idempotent
